Clearbridge Llc increased its stake in Store Cap Corp (STOR) by 21.86% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Clearbridge Llc bought 153,920 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.03% with the market. The institutional investor held 858,080 shares of the real estate investment trusts company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $22.34 million, up from 704,160 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Clearbridge Llc who had been investing in Store Cap Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $5.06 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.16% or $0.04 during the last trading session, reaching $25.57. About 796,784 shares traded. STORE Capital Corporation (NYSE:STOR) has risen 4.52% since May 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 7.03% the S&P500.
Crestpoint Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Intel (INTC) by 30.15% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Crestpoint Capital Management Llc sold 25,300 shares as the company’s stock rose 9.61% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 58,600 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.71M, down from 83,900 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Crestpoint Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Intel for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $249.31 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 2.39% or $1.31 during the last trading session, reaching $53.5. About 21.27 million shares traded. Intel Corporation (NASDAQ:INTC) has risen 44.65% since May 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 33.10% the S&P500.
